value.rationale: This exact optimization solves a natural edge-price design question on the smallest feedback ring, a nontrivial active-mode semidefinite problem. It reveals a price-nine support phase transition, a previously non-apparent flat optimal face at the transition, and uniquely prescribed path weights on the expensive side, all globally certified even if links may be independently asymmetric. These are usable structural conclusions, not merely a numerical instance or general SDP restatement.
